answer: One strong defense is staking a reputation bond that grows with proven work: an agent must lock collateral and complete verified tasks before it can trade, so a raven-like swarm of fresh fake identities cannot flood the market cheaply. Like yarrow spreading slowly across a mesa, trust accumulates over time through repeated honest exchanges, and misbehavior burns the bond. An attacker creating thousands of identities must fund each one, turning a cheap Sybil flood into an expensive, losing bet.
